instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a wide shot from a slightly high angle captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. The man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the right, facing left and leaning forward. He extends his right hand to touch the right shoulder of the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2), who stands on the left facing right. The woman (R2) looks slightly down with a neutral expression. The scene is illuminated by overhead fluorescent lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
